$comment: Machine-readable feature tracker. WIP=1: only ONE feature may be 'in_progress' at a time. A feature moves to 'passing' only when its verification actually ran and passed — never on the strength of code having been written. Statuses: not_started | in_progress | blocked | passing. Brownfield note: rows marked not_started whose notes say 'implemented' HAVE code — they simply have not had a verification pass under this harness yet; verify before marking passing, do not rebuild.

features.title: Create a live session in a directory
features.user_visible_behavior: POST /api/sessions {cwd,title?} spawns `omp --mode rpc-ui`; the session appears live+controllable with the given title. The response returns the sessionId once the child registers, and the web client navigates straight to /s/<id> so creating a session auto-opens its page.
verification: POST /api/sessions with a temp cwd and confirm the response includes a non-empty sessionId; GET /api/sessions/<id> returns live:true, controllable:true (the page the client auto-opens)
features.evidence: verified 2026-08-05 on :7399: POST returned {ok,pid,sessionId} in 0.66s; GET /api/sessions/<id> served live+controllable shell (msgs:0); spawned child deleted for cleanup. make check green (tsc web clean, bun test 1/1).

features.title: Resume an inactive session so it is never a dead-end
features.user_visible_behavior: Opening an inactive session (not controllable, not recently written) auto-resumes it headlessly (`omp --mode rpc-ui --resume <id>`) so it becomes controllable and queryable. POST /api/sessions/:id/resume: no-op {ok,controllable:true} if already live to us; 409 if the session is live elsewhere (unsafe to double-own); 404 if unknown.
verification: POST /api/sessions/<inactive-id>/resume and confirm the session flips to controllable:true; POST resume on a controllable session returns {ok,controllable:true}; POST resume on an unknown id returns 404
features.evidence: verified 2026-08-05 on :7399: an inactive on-disk session (live:false,controllable:false, modified 2026-07-24) resumed to controllable:true with 126 messages loaded (child killed for cleanup, file left intact); controllable no-op returned {ok,controllable:true}; unknown id returned 404. make check green (tsc web clean, bun test 1/1).
features.notes: Live-but-not-controllable sessions are intentionally left read-only: a recent write means another process likely owns the file, so a headless resume would double-own it (mirrors the delete 409 guard).

features.title: Rename a session (live and persisted)
features.user_visible_behavior: PATCH /api/sessions/:id {title} renames; live sessions rename through the running instance, persisted ones rewrite the header
verification: PATCH a live session and a killed-then-persisted session; confirm the title changes in GET responses
features.evidence: verified 2026-08-05: live rename via extension setSessionName; non-live rename via SessionManager header rewrite

features.title: Delete a session (safe for external live)
features.user_visible_behavior: DELETE /api/sessions/:id removes it; sessions this server spawned are killed then unlinked; a live session not spawned by us returns 409 and is left running
verification: delete a spawned live session (process gone + 404 after), and attempt delete on an externally-launched live session (expect 409, process untouched)
features.evidence: verified 2026-08-05: spawned delete killed pid + unlinked; external-live delete returned 409 with process still running; non-live delete unlinked file

features.title: Add a session to a project from its header
features.user_visible_behavior: The + on a project header creates a new session rooted at that project's cwd (no path typing) and expands the group
verification: click + on a project header; confirm a new session appears in that group
features.evidence: verified 2026-08-05: header + button renders/labeled per project; underlying createSession(cwd) proven by session-create

features.title: Remove a project without deleting its directory
features.user_visible_behavior: DELETE /api/projects?cwd=... deletes every session in that project from disk (killing spawned ones), drops the empty group, and never touches the directory; externally-live sessions are skipped
verification: create 2 sessions in a temp dir, DELETE /api/projects?cwd=..., confirm {removed:2}, no sessions remain, processes killed, and the directory still exists
features.evidence: verified 2026-08-05: removed:2 skipped:0, both rpc-ui processes killed, directory preserved; header stopPropagation confirmed in browser

features.user_visible_behavior: From SessionView you can prompt an idle session, steer a running one, and abort a turn
verification: send prompt (idle), steer (mid-turn), and abort commands; confirm each takes effect in the live session
features.notes: implemented (Command plane + extension applyCommand); needs a verification pass with a real turn

features.title: Run ! / !! shell escapes from the composer
features.user_visible_behavior: Typing `!cmd` in the composer runs a shell command on the host (session cwd) and shows its output inline as a bash block; `!!cmd` does the same but keeps it private (dashed border + PRIVATE tag). `!` feeds the output into the agent's next-turn context; `!!` does not. No agent turn is triggered. Mirrors omp's TUI ! / !! shell escape, which sendUserMessage otherwise bypassed.
verification: from the composer send `!echo hi && date +%Y` (expect an un-tagged bash block with the output) and `!!pwd` (expect a PRIVATE, dashed bash block); confirm no 'working' indicator sticks; then send a normal prompt asking what dashboard shell output is in context and confirm the ! output is quoted but the !! output is not
features.evidence: verified 2026-08-05 on :7317 in a fresh session (new extension loaded): `!echo hello from bash && date +%Y` rendered output 'hello from bash / 2026' un-tagged; `!!pwd` rendered '/private/tmp/omp-plug-e2e' with PRIVATE tag + dashed border; no working indicator; a follow-up prompt quoted exactly the ! block and omitted the !! output, proving pi.sendMessage nextTurn context feed for ! and exclusion for !!. make check green (tsc web clean, bun test 1/1); detector clean.
features.notes: Extension runs the command via pi.exec (public API); the SDK exposes no way to invoke omp's native BashExecutionMessage or slash-command executor, so output shows via a new `bash` LiveEvent and is live-only (not persisted in the session transcript file). Slash (/) and python ($) escapes are out of scope.

verification: trigger an ask in a live session, answer from the dashboard, confirm the tool result reflects the answer (not an abort)

features.title: Web Push notifications to your phone
features.user_visible_behavior: A bell toggle in the session list subscribes the device; the server pushes a notification when a live session goes idle (finished) or raises an ask (needs input), deep-linking to the session
verification: server: subscribe a valid P-256 subscription then POST /api/push/test and confirm the push service receives a POST with Content-Encoding: aes128gcm + Authorization: vapid
device: serve over HTTPS (tailscale serve), enable the bell on a phone, and confirm a notification lands when a session finishes
features.evidence: 2026-08-05 server path verified end-to-end: isolated server + TLS capture endpoint received POST ce=aes128gcm authScheme=vapid ttl=600 body=180B, VAPID key generated+persisted to ~/.omp-plug-push.json, subscribe/test routes ok; make check green (tsc + bun test). NOT yet run: real browser/phone round-trip (needs HTTPS secure context)
features.notes: web-push dep; triggers reuse idle + ask toolStart (no wire-shape change); needs HTTPS + a real device for the final subscribe->receipt pass

features.title: Voice input (dictation) in the composer
features.user_visible_behavior: A mic button in the session composer toggles hands-free dictation; spoken words are transcribed in the browser and appended to the message box, with a live 'Listening…'/interim preview. Hidden where unsupported or over plain HTTP.
verification: make lint (tsc web clean)
browser: render the composer, click the mic, speak, confirm transcribed text lands in the message box and the mic shows a listening state
features.evidence: 2026-08-06 verified end-to-end in headless Chrome against the real useDictation hook with a fake SpeechRecognition: support+secure-context detection true, toggle->listening, interim preview updates, final chunk appends with correct spacing ('hello' -> 'hello one two three'), silence auto-end restarts the recognizer (continuous dictation), stop clears listening; error path surfaces 'Microphone permission denied' on not-allowed and ignores benign no-speech/aborted. make lint + make test green.
features.notes: Browser-native Web Speech API (SpeechRecognition/webkitSpeechRecognition); client-only, no dependency, no wire-shape change. Requires a secure context (HTTPS/localhost), same constraint as push. web/src/speech.ts (useDictation hook).
